name: Eve Door & Window (EU)

radios.note: Eve's page lists Thread as the wireless connection; CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth (Bluetooth is used for Matter setup).

matter.note: CSA has several Eve Door & Window listings (vendor 0x130A, product 0x004D, firmware 3.1.0 to 3.2.1), all Thread and Bluetooth. Eve says the latest HomeKit/Thread models got Matter through a free firmware update.

apple_home.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller). On Apple that means a HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller).

alexa.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller). Eve's hub page names Amazon Alexa among the platforms with such hubs.

smartthings.note: Needs a Thread border router (a hub that is also a Matter controller). Eve's hub page names Samsung SmartThings among the platforms with such hubs.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Eve page lists Eve Door & Window as a Matter device, added locally through the Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router.

hubRequired.note: No Eve bridge is needed. Eve says the first platform needs a hub with Matter controller and Thread border router functions (e.g. HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K); that is a generic Thread border router, not a brand hub.

localControl.note: Eve's page says no Eve cloud and no registration; the CSA listing describes fully local connectivity.

senses.note: Eve and CSA describe it as an open/closed sensor with time and duration statistics.

power.note: Eve's page lists one replaceable ½ AA (ER14250, 3.6 V) cell, included.

summary: Eve Door & Window is a small contact sensor that tells you whether a door, window or drawer is open. The Matter version talks Thread, so Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant can all use it through Matter. Each platform needs a Thread border router, and Eve says it needs no account or cloud. It runs on one replaceable half-AA cell.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router; it does not join a network without one.
Units sold before the Matter version were HomeKit devices; Eve offers a free Matter firmware update for the latest Thread-enabled models.
Pairing to several platforms uses Matter multi-admin; each extra platform needs its own Matter controller.

sources.title: Eve Welcomes Matter with Free Firmware Updates for Three Eve Products
